binding: 22 actual current dirty files match INPUT_SNAPSHOT, historical HEAD not acceptance

findings.title: completion失败仍释放active scope；清理不确定没有维持全生产barrier
findings.concrete_trigger: PRE/POST的release抛真实cleanup异常，state.tree_release=false；或父drain未证后退出。factory构造supervisor时未传实际scope，#holdForCleanup不能标记该scope。
findings.impact: mint返回null、complete返回false，outer finally仍无条件release；release只检查cleanup_required而非phase completion，于是service自身uncertain但全局root/容量被归还，别的owner可进入同物理根。同一operation也已reject，不再是完整promise pending。
findings.minimum_fix: 绑定真实scope到run责任，在所有父/tree不确定分支保留wholeProduction与scope；只在完整真实completion成功消费后释放。未出生/NOT_OWNED拒绝路径需签明真实零资源阶段，不能把普通finally可达当execution证明。
findings.counterfactual_test: 故障注入一棵tree close失败与父drain不确定，观察同root另一owner排队不获准/PRE责任仍持有；真正reconcile完成后原失败返回且仅一次release。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: 所谓私有一次completion实际由导出mint接受布尔receipt并可重复消费
findings.concrete_trigger: 任何持同一真实scope的Host-private调用者导入mint，传三个{settled:true,digest:null}；消费后再标held并重用同一个completion。
findings.impact: 没有owner/reservation/阶段issuer或真实receipt认证，outcome可任填；WeakMap只证明调用过该导出函数，consume也不delete/消费一次，不复核generation/active/原outcome。现有scheduler测试本身用手造布尔receipt证明这条路径可通，与合同禁止caller布尔mint相反。
findings.minimum_fix: 将mint权限封在真实scope owner闭包，用各阶段私有issuer签发的receipt且绑定reservation/root/generation/outcome；消费验证同一active责任并立即删除/标spent，不能有通用导出mint(raw booleans)。
findings.counterfactual_test: 外部Host模块持真实scope但仅伪造phase shape不得mint；外来receipt/原outcome不符拒绝；消费后同completion再次clear held必须失败。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: execution证明与reconcile均未验证custodian receipt/可接受退出
findings.concrete_trigger: C报告DOMAIN_REAPED但outcome=unknown、echild=false或identity/draw不符；或C异常死亡且Host所见N组刚好gone，或尚未保存worker identity。
findings.impact: run只校验kind；facts.receipt赋值后从不被证明函数读取，reconcile也不检查receipt。#proveDomainGone只需C close及已知组/少量knownIDs gone，worker=null可直接成功；C退出code/signal未成为资格门。#terminate还会把仍在回收的C升级SIGKILL，随后同一弱证明可能settle，不能证明C已reap全部收养children。
findings.minimum_fix: 严格校验协议/seq/digest/draw/C/N身份、outcome=reaped/ECHILD/组及knownIDs等完整receipt，并结合真实C exit/close与fresh观察；缺失/unknown/坏receipt或C意外死亡必须hold。异常清理不能主动杀掉唯一reaper后声称正常结算。失败路径的receipt也须持续接收并保存，不能只在成功候选分支读一次。
findings.counterfactual_test: 缺receipt、wrong draw/identity、unknown/ECHILD=false、C非0或SIGKILL、preNidentity阶段C崩溃，各自保持barrier；合法完整回执+真实close作正向对照。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: candidate状态阻止后续失败锁存，取消/协议/洪水不再优先
findings.concrete_trigger: 已接收合法picture并置latched.kind=candidate后，closed/receipt缺失、协议错误或超限；#latchFailure被调用。
findings.impact: #latchFailure对candidate直接return。facts.error仍null，后续#fail可能只产生空结果，held reconcile则走candidate成功分支；候选以后本应取消/失败的事实未锁存。
findings.minimum_fix: candidate不是终态：后续第一次failure/cancel必须覆盖candidate资格并保存原error；只有失败之间首因不覆盖。将实际取消signal接入该状态机，最后交付前检查它。
findings.counterfactual_test: 候选后missing/fatal receipt、late flood、cancel竞态，证明原失败/取消原因保持且零witness，之后正常对照能成功。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: 按owner+root取最后登记责任，排队请求可遮蔽正在held的真实draw
findings.concrete_trigger: 同一issued producer/root上A正在执行或held，另一个direct/bridge调用B先登记后排队；inspect/reconcile A时list最后一项已是B。
findings.impact: bridge/workspace会暴露或推进B的reserved handle，A无法通过生产reconcile找回；A父drain后还会把B.parentDrained写true。没有把具体bridge/draw/scope责任绑定到continuation，两个同root serving bridge也会共享这条root查询。
findings.minimum_fix: 将每次bridge.draw同步捕获其实际responsibility并闭包贯穿execution/parent receipt；inspect列出未结责任或稳定issued handle，reconcile直接由该handle找对应责任，不以最新root记录替代。
findings.counterfactual_test: A held时排队B，A的旧真实handle仍可正确reconcile，B不能被误标parentDrained；foreign bridge/service真实handle拒绝。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: 责任历史无限保留且保存完整JPEG Buffer
findings.concrete_trigger: 长寿producer连续完成多个合法draw。
findings.impact: WeakMap value数组只append从不删，outcome保存settlement.picture完整Buffer；每draw至多8MiB累计保留，不受2active/32queue限制。普通成功路径会持续增长内存，close遍历全部历史。
findings.minimum_fix: active/held责任用Map按draw保存；全生产结束后删除大对象和已结记录，只保留有界摘要/诊断，真正held仍保留。
findings.counterfactual_test: 循环多个成功draw后只剩当前active/held和有界summary，历史Buffer无强引用；同时held诊断仍可reconcile。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: 无workspace的bridge在父drain之前归还direct scope
findings.concrete_trigger: 通过已签发真实bridge.draw调用，未携带workspace ambient scope；producer取得direct scope，execution结束后父probe/源流仍在。
findings.impact: producer.pageFrame自己的finally先release，然后bridge才freeze/drain/endDraw；下一同root draw可在旧父资源未结时写。producer.close所等settled也在父drain前resolve，与完整accepted生产责任合同不符。
findings.minimum_fix: bridge自身取得并持有包含execution+parent阶段的真实scope/责任，producer复用ambient不提前释放；真正裸factory仅execution模式须构造期明确区分，不让bridge冒充无父资源direct调用。
findings.counterfactual_test: 真实bridge的父probe/source close被barrier延后，下一同root draw和close保持等待；drain/endDraw真实完成才一次归还根。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: decoder外的frame队列仍无界，三次READY也重新各给30秒
findings.concrete_trigger: 远端持续写很多完整小frame，每次feed未消费buffer很小但controlFrames/drawFrames累积；或每个启动阶段接近30秒才响应。
findings.impact: decoder把完整frame移出后外部数组无限push，未限制阶段帧数/总积压；控制decode失败只改drawFailure而nextControl不看，洪水也仅flag。完整两级READY实际可近90秒，违反已冻结总30秒；Host draw EOF也无即时控制cancel监听。
findings.minimum_fix: 约束包含解析后队列的总bytes/count并按协议阶段立即拒绝，超限/EOF触发同一cleanup；所有启动步骤共享一个绝对READY deadline，不能每个next重置。
findings.counterfactual_test: 每次仅发合法尺寸小帧的累计洪水、无waiter积压、control decode错误、draw EOF以及三阶段延迟，均真实有界失败清理，正常批量metadata+JPEG可通过。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: P2a helper/断言不能证明目标场景且失败时会漏清理
findings.concrete_trigger: fault worker用go.ticket_digest（Host仅发送ticket）回结果；foreign-hello模式在HELLO之后才由rel解析；probe helper仅unref interval+未决顶层await；probe断言在kill前失败。
findings.impact: worker先撞PROTOCOL_FOREIGN，不能证明预期正常/TERM-ignore/late分支；foreign HELLO场景实际未实现。probe helper不保证活着（未决Promise不保活，且close-stdio模式后续写已end stderr有错误风险）。测试没有finally清理，断言失败可留下被测child；custodian正常测试却调用fixtureSupervisor并只看Host组计数，源流测试也没制造close前barrier/FD事实。
findings.minimum_fix: worker按go.ticket计算digest，preHELLO故障由受控fixture启动协议具名提供；probe用明确ref存活句柄且结束后不写已关stderr；测试启动即注册所有真实child到finally/afterEach TERM-KILL-close账本，UNKNOWN保留目录。增加真正正常成功/目标故障直接receipt、Z与FD事件断言，不用rejects任意错误/Host组计数。
findings.counterfactual_test: 先非故障fixture完整成功；每scenario断言具体命中原因；故意让中途expect失败仍真正reap全部child；真实source close延迟与probe callback/error/exit/close完整事件矩阵。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: 被称为纯identity门的测试确实调用真实Python spawn路径
findings.concrete_trigger: 已捕获identity整文件中的starts a draw only once执行owner.start(handle)。
findings.impact: start直接执行#run，立即spawn /usr/bin/python3.12 -I -S -B /nonexistent/custodian.py；没有stub或阻断seam。源码证明spawn调用被执行，捕获未记录child PID/close，不能从29/29推称无child；这不代表真实custodian/prctl已经跑过。测试故意不await first，未保证所启动child settled。
findings.minimum_fix: 将首次start需要真实child的断言移到明确P2a并等待清理；纯阶段测试抽取不出生的状态过渡/受审私有seam，不在纯门中调用实际#run。纠正报告的绝对无真实进程陈述，保留现有capture。
findings.counterfactual_test: 纯门以spawn-call observer/fitness证明零birth call；P2a重复start用真实child证明一次birth并最终close。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: workspace排队未传已有abort
findings.impact: acquire只传mode，没有signal，queue不立即取消；虽然后续lease guard防late GO，close仍无谓等待30秒deadline，未实现F08/合同所承诺的取消排队。
findings.minimum_fix: 传service已有abort signal并在scope grant后的准入门复核；queue取消只归还已占用部分。
findings.counterfactual_test: 占满两scope后排队workspace生产，close立即移除自己的reservation、零PRE/child，另owner不受影响。
findings.contract: ADR060 rev3 and 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT sections A/B/C; prior P1 findings as linked
findings.authority_limit: Host-private lifecycle/code interface; no assertion of a public HTTP capability-forgery exploit

findings.title: 两次新的开发失败仍缺原始证据，不能与旧失败混淆
findings.facts: 报告承认P1R另有两次未经recorder的新identity/scheduler断言失败。已检查W/docs与W/var中060p1r失败命名记录，未找到原命令/exit/log/input；11条可核验成功capture不能替代它们。具体失败argv、时刻与日志路径为UNRECORDED/UNKNOWN，不把最终成功命令冒充原失败命令。release明确all_failures_must_be_recorded_before_first_run=true，承认不等于已留存。
findings.generation: generate-001记录是许可的较早generation之后同字节重复；source_changed=[]和manifest hash相符，不能称为捕获了首次源码mutation。不得补造旧日志。

findings.title: 默认Q2上游probe未被擅自替换，但当前promise不是普遍reap证明
findings.facts: frameDuration仍为固定上游promise，源stream现在error保留/close单独settle、destroy异常保留确有改善。父probe正常/error/kill路径、source-FD barrier与freeze输入仍需P2a直接证据，未跑本身不是新codefinding；必须补实际ffprobe及注入live-error对照，不能只跑小Node helper。

P2a_safety_prerequisites: 修复IR01–IR08的owner/receipt/terminal关键缺口后冻结新的精确bytes再静态检查，不能直接批准当前整文件P2a。
先修IR09/IR10的helper存活、真实协议命中和所有断言失败finally cleanup；每个真实child启动即登记真实handle/identity，最后TERM→KILL→真实close/reap，UNKNOWN保留目录。
非浏览器P2a只给明确scenario/argv/cwd/输出根/一heavy slot；custodian/receipt/ECHILD/Z/peer/失联负例逐个有正常成功对照，小helper不代表Chrome。
实际loopback/source/drain/probe需分别精确grant；Q2保持默认，真实ffprobe normal/cache与error/kill回调事件pilot后才考虑具名窄owner。
当前cache-process-settlement及旧witness/reader包含真实浏览器路径，不能把报告§7全命令当non-browser P2a；Chrome只在另票P2b。
执行前固定Python/Node/worker/policy/integrity摘要、两通道FD/receipt及owned child HOME/XDG隔离；当前#childEnvironment仍复制父HOME/XDG，应先落实私有合同D，不读取用户配置来验证。
严格recorder在第一次开发测试之前启用；新失败独立捕获，不覆盖11条成功和两次UNRECORDED承认。
